versions.changelog:
Initial release of mimo-omni: multimodal analysis with Xiaomi MiMo models.

- Supports image, video, and audio understanding via Xiaomi MiMo API.
- Provides shell (bash) and Python CLI tools for all major platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux).
- Handles diverse tasks: image description, object detection, OCR, video and audio interpretation, and transcription.
- Allows direct input of user questions in any language; thorough example usage included.
- Includes guidance for handling file size limits, timeouts, and platform-specific instructions.
